name: TDI Custom Packaging Inc
old_description: “I have ordered large quantities of product from TDI since 2000. I have found TDI to be price competitive, professional and prompt with their delivery. The quality control is excellent and their after-sale record keeping, invoicing, and office contact is timely and accurate.”
about:
TDI Custom Packaging operates from Santa Ana, California, where it has produced custom polyethylene packaging since 1974. The company was founded by Anthony "Tony" Deniger, who began with blown-film extrusion in El Monte before moving to Orange County. It remains a family-owned business, with management directly accessible to customers.

The shop extrudes, converts, and prints a range of high- and low-density polyethylene films, bags, sleeves, tubing, and sheeting. It runs blown-film lines capable of widths from 1 to 42 inches and lengths up to 196 inches, and offers flexographic printing up to four colors on one side or two colors on two sides. Minimum orders start at 100 pounds for narrower widths, and the company emphasizes smaller quantity runs with a current lead time of about four weeks.

TDI serves nurseries with grow bags and plant sleeves, the medical market with gel ice bags, and a broad base of industrial packagers. Long-term customers include a nursery client since 1991 and buyers who have ordered regularly since 1976 and 2000.

The founder's stated philosophy is to supply hard-to-find custom sizes, colors, and formulations that large extruders and importers do not stock. The company highlights its family-owned structure, direct decision-making, FDA-approved resins, and compliance with AQMD and EPA standards as differentiators.
